subject: Marketplace Partner Paper - redlines on pass-through / MSA alignment
messages:
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@marketplacecloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@marketplacecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace partner paper - redlines attached

Jonas,

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached are MarketplaceCloud's redlines to the partner paper and the marketplace addendum. High level: we flagged language around pass-through liabilities, indemnity carveouts, and a clause that would require us to accept Redwood's MSA as "customer paper" which our legal team can't do for marketplace listings.

Key asks from our side:
- Limit pass-through of liability so it only applies to direct breaches by the partner (no upstream vendor pass-through).
- Remove the customer-paper carve (we need reciprocal, marketplace standard language).
- Explicit confidentiality carve for billing data used for marketplace reporting.

I've attached a PDF with inline comments (MarketplaceCloud_partner_paper_redlines_20251203.pdf). Can you loop in your legal? We'd like to get to a mutually acceptable version quickly so we can list within this quarter.

Thanks,
Tom Keller
VP, Partnerships
MarketplaceCloud

Attachment: MarketplaceCloud_partner_paper_redlines_20251203.pdf (PDF, 21 pages, inline comments)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@marketplacecloud.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace partner paper - redlines attached

Tom — appreciate the quick turnaround and the call earlier. Looping in our legal (David) and Sales Ops (Lauren) + product partner (Grace) to review the redlines.

David: can you take the lead on the pass-through / indemnity language? Tom's team is asking us to restrict pass-through liability and avoid accepting their MSA as "customer paper" for marketplace listing. We want to preserve Redwood's risk posture but also move this to execution this quarter if possible.

Lauren: FYI on timelines — MarketplaceCloud is hoping for listing within Q4. If we can get a final doc by EOD Thu we'll route signature.

Tom: we'll review and come back with proposed compromise language.

—Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0124

Attachment: RW_redline_request_log.txt (1 line: request logged by Sales)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@marketplacecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 15:27:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace partner paper - redlines attached

Team / Tom — thanks for the redlines and the context. I reviewed MarketplaceCloud_partner_paper_redlines_20251203.pdf and prepared a short response with compromise language. Summary below and proposed text attached (RW_redline_response_20251203.docx).

Summary of positions and proposed compromises:
1) Pass-through liability (Sec. 8): MarketplaceCloud asks to limit liability pass-through. We are willing to accept pass-through for direct claims arising from Partner's misuse of Redwood services, but we cannot accept unlimited upstream vendor pass-through (e.g., if the Partner is simply a reseller and the end-customer sues due to Redwood's service failure). Proposed: "Partner will be liable for claims arising from Partner's acts or omissions in reselling the Service; Redwood's liability to Partner and to any downstream party shall remain subject to the limitations and exclusions in the MSA."

2) Customer-paper carve / MSA alignment (Sec. 2): We cannot wholesale accept MarketplaceCloud's template as customer paper for all marketplace listings. We propose a mutual-recognition clause where both parties accept the marketplace addendum as the operative commercial attachment for marketplace listings; if either party needs to rely on its standalone MSA, it must present it and we will negotiate in good faith for that specific listing.

3) Billing/confidentiality carve (Sec. 5): Accept limited confidentiality carve for billing/usage data required for marketplace reporting. Add audit-limited access and data minimization.

If Tom can accept those three bullets, we can produce a signature-ready addendum with track changes. If MarketplaceCloud requires additional pass-through scope, we will need a business sign-off from Finance (Lauren) on the exposure.

I've attached the suggested redline doc with exact language we recommend. Happy to hop on 30 minutes tomorrow to resolve remaining items.

—David
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: RW_redline_response_20251203.docx (Word doc with proposed language and clause-by-clause mapping)

From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@marketplacecloud.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@marketplacecloud.com>, MarketplaceCloud Legal Team <legal@marketplacecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 08:19:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace partner paper - redlines attached

David / Jonas — thanks for the clear summary and the proposed language. MarketplaceCloud legal has discussed internally and we can accept the approach on the pass-through carve you proposed, with one tweak: we request that the carve explicitly permit pass-through where the downstream claim arises from Partner's representations about listing attributes (e.g., if Partner misstates pricing or features in MarketplaceCloud listing).

On the customer-paper point, we can agree to "mutual recognition for marketplace listings" as long as the addendum expressly states that for the purposes of listing only, the addendum governs. That should be acceptable.

We'd like Redwood to produce the signature-ready addendum with your proposed language tracked so we can confirm there are no hidden edits. Once that's ready we'll circulate for signature.

Tom
VP, Partnerships
MarketplaceCloud

Attachment: none (we reviewed RW_redline_response_20251203.docx and provided feedback inline)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Lauren — can you confirm procurement can approve the exposure at the level David outlined? If yes, we'll send the addendum to DocuSign and copy MarketplaceCloud's signatories. Target: execution by Friday to hit their listing timeline.

Tom / Elena — I will send the DocuSign link once we have the final PDF. Please confirm the signatory on your side (name, title, email) so we can pre-fill the envelope.

Thanks team — moving to close.

—Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
